description: A made bed with a green sheet and a dark blue pillow is in front, and there’s a small green object near the center of the sheet. The left hand stays planted on the sheet near the green object while the right hand, holding a flat tan-and-blue item, moves back and forth and lightly presses or rubs against the sheet near the left hand, then eases away, with the bed surface acting as a two-hand object by contact.
